title: The Deficit Hawk's Reversal
thesis: The chamber's most reliable deficit hawk authored the largest unfunded package of his career, a reversal that quietly confirms the politics of austerity have collapsed.
body:
The most reliable deficit hawk in the chamber spent a decade warning that unfunded spending would break the country. This month he wrote the largest unfunded package of his career [sy_4f593774e9e3, sy_db8cd8e744fc].

<then-now>
<then>On the 2024 trail he made a balanced budget the centerpiece of his platform, calling new deficit spending "generational theft" [sy_4f593774e9e3].</then>
<now>This June he sponsored a $900 billion domestic-investment bill that the budget office scores as deeply unfunded [sy_db8cd8e744fc].</now>
</then-now>

<card kind="story">[sy_db8cd8e744fc]</card>

<stat value="$1.4T" label="projected ten-year addition to the deficit from the new package">the number he once called disqualifying [sy_db8cd8e744fc]</stat>

<callout>The reversal is not hypocrisy so much as a confession: the politics of austerity died quietly, and even its loudest champion has stopped paying for the funeral [sy_4f593774e9e3, sy_db8cd8e744fc]</callout>
